Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.dataslices

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.dataslices
Maps the request/response payloads used to export and import data slices (grids of cell data), plus a GridDefinitionBuilder for constructing requests. Mostly internal plumbing, though a few types here - such as DataSlice - are also used directly as method return/parameter types by PbcsPlanType.
